title: Self-Tuning Workflow for Automated Cryo-EM Data Collection in SmartScope
content: High-throughput data collection in single-particle cryo-electron microscopy (cryo-EM) follows a semi-automated workflow in which microscopists preselect acquisition areas, and automated software executes imaging. However, this rigid approach often fails to maximize data quality within the allocated experimental time, as the system blindly follows predefined selections without real-time feedback.
